title: Generalized reaction is one semantic state transformer with internal analysis/synthesis/publication refinement
semanticClaim: Gamma denotes exactly one transition from reaction-start state to one successor state.
Analysis, synthesis and publication are an internal refinement decomposition of that one transition, not separate semantic machine commands.
Synthesis depends only on the analysis result; publication receives the original reaction-start state plus staged result.
For one reaction-start state the Gamma successor is unique.
explicitPremises: Analysis is modeled as a pure function of the reaction-start state.
Synthesis is modeled as a pure function of the analysis value.
Publication is modeled as a deterministic function of the reaction-start state and staged value.
exclusions: This does not yet prove a concrete implementation cannot expose staged writes to analysis; generation isolation is GPR-03.
This does not yet prove partition/scheduler independence; that is GPR-04.
Analysis/staging objects are external proof/refinement machinery, not MTS ontology or semantic states.
